Ayodhya Ram Temple donation case: Probe identifies alleged theft

The Special Investigation Team (SIT) has identified nearly 70 instances of alleged theft from the temple's counting room over a span of around 40 days. The probe names Avinash Shukla as prime accused in the Ayodhya Ram Temple donation case. The SIT's findings have raised questions about the handling of donations and the management of the temple's finances.
